taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Recovery objectives are tiered: critical configuration/decision/alert/audit/evidence-index metadata target RPO at most 15 minutes; critical observations/checkpoints target at most 60 minutes; replayable raw payloads may target at most 24 hours when rights permit reconstruction.

PostgreSQL uses point-in-time recovery or an equivalent tested mechanism, object storage uses versioning/immutability where supported, and encryption keys/recovery credentials are separately protected and tested.
